description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Guide Pins used between the Cylinder Head and the Engine Block.
These pins are used to guide the parts into the correct location during assembly.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Guide Pins
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
